ProjectName: Sensitive Field Masking and Audit Remediation (Catalog-Grounded UAT)

Review.ItemLabel: UAT-1: BackofficeUser sees the SSN masked when no exemption is active
Review.Feedback: CATALOG GAP: pre-auth /login and /dev/email-inbox are intentionally not in the crawled catalog (the crawler authenticates first). Labels for those steps and for popover/menu/dialog content (role-switch menu items, snackbar text, in-tab Compliance Review and Mask Exemption sub-panels) are carried from the prior UAT run. All catalog-grounded steps below use verbatim entries from docs/component-catalog/index.json for the active route x role.

Steps.Action: NAVIGATE TO "http://localhost:5010/login"

Verifications.Text: VERIFY the login page is visible

Steps.Action: CLICK INPUT with label "Email address" and enter "admin@acmecoffee.com"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Send sign-in link"
WAIT FOR "the page displays the text 'We sent a sign-in code to'"
NAVIGATE TO "http://localhost:5010/dev/email-inbox"
WAIT FOR "the most-recent email row's Link cell contains an anchor whose href matches '/login?token='"
CLICK LINK in "the most-recent email row in /dev/email-inbox" with text "sign-in link"
WAIT FOR "the navigation drawer displays an icon button with aria-label 'Toggle Admin'"
CLICK ICON BUTTON with aria-label "System Admin, switch role"
CLICK MENU ITEM with label "Backoffice User"
VERIFY SNACKBAR shows "Now viewing as 'Backoffice User'."
CLICK LINK with text "Retail Businesses"
CLICK ROW in "Retail Businesses" where "Account Email" = "james.smith@example.com"
VERIFY URL matches "/customers/[0-9]+$"
VERIFY TEXT matches "XXX-XX-[0-9*]+"

Verifications.Text: VERIFY the SSN field renders as a masked value beginning with 'XXX-XX-'

Steps.Action: VERIFY ELEMENT with label "Social Security Number" is not visible

Verifications.Text: VERIFY the editable Social Security Number input is not rendered, confirming the field is masked

Review.ItemLabel: UAT-5: Row expander renders the correlation cluster section (judgment)
Review.Feedback: Judgment item - visual layout, grouping, and readability of the correlation cluster section cannot be fully automated. The Playwright test verifies the expander panel renders content (cluster table or 'No other rows' message); the human judges whether the layout reads clearly.

Steps.Action: NAVIGATE TO "http://localhost:5010/login"
CLICK INPUT with label "Email address" and enter "admin@acmecoffee.com"
CLICK BUTTON with caption "Send sign-in link"
WAIT FOR "the page displays the text 'We sent a sign-in code to'"
NAVIGATE TO "http://localhost:5010/dev/email-inbox"
WAIT FOR "the most-recent email row's Link cell contains an anchor whose href matches '/login?token='"
